verdict.rationale: Otter documents admin audit trails and activity logs, which give some admin visibility into account activity, and offers Channels as shared team spaces. However, no granular link, folder or workspace sharing permissions are documented, and community reports say conversations are shared with all meeting participants by default, which undercuts private-by-default. Missing for 10: private-by-default notes, documented granular link/folder/workspace sharing permissions, explicit admin visibility into what is shared, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared

citations.quote: Maintain visibility into account activity with audit trails and logging, supporting your security, compliance, and regulatory reporting needs.
Enhanced admin features: activity logs, usage analytics, and more
Meetings grouped by team, project, or topic so everyone can find recordings and collaborate in one shared space.
